ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a composite rose bed. At the bottom there is one large upright square. Its top side is also the horizontal base of a right-angled triangle above it. On the two slanted legs of that triangle there are two tilted squares, and these two tilted squares are shown as equal in size. A vertical dimension marker indicates the total height of the whole bed is 16 m. Reasoning: Let the side length of the lower large square be s. Since the two tilted white squares are equal, the two legs of the right triangle on which they are built are equal. Therefore the yellow right triangle is a 45-45-90 triangle, and the lower square's top side, length s, is the hypotenuse of that triangle. Each leg of the triangle is s/sqrt(2), so each white square has area (s/sqrt(2))^2 = s^2/2. Together the two white squares have area s^2. From the diagram geometry, the lower square extends s below the triangle base, and the tilted squares reach s above that same base, so the total height is 2s. Since the total height is 16 m, 2s = 16, so s = 8. The lower square area is s^2 = 64. The two white squares together also have area s^2 = 64. The right isosceles triangle has area s^2/4 = 64/4 = 16. Therefore the total bed area is 64 + 64 + 16 = 144 m^2.

method.method_draft: First read the image: the lower large square has its top side as the base of the yellow right triangle, and the two equal tilted white squares are constructed on the two legs of that triangle. Since the two white squares are equally big, the two legs of the right triangle are equal, so the yellow triangle is a 45-45-90 triangle and the lower square's side is the hypotenuse. Let the side of the lower square be s. From the image geometry, the vertical distance above the triangle's base to the top of a tilted square is s, while the lower square extends s below the base, so the total height is 2s. The text gives the height as 16 m, hence s = 8. Then each white square has side s/sqrt(2), area s^2/2; the two white squares together have area s^2. The lower square has area s^2, and the right isosceles triangle has area s^2/4. Total area = s^2 + s^2 + s^2/4 = 9s^2/4 = 9*64/4 = 144 m^2.
